about: v0.7 accepted test results, read by run-all.sh. Guarded by check-control.js against the approved baseline tag. Counts were verified on development/v0.7 at the reference commit (11 Nov 2026) and match the A1 record. Change this file ONLY in a commit that records why, with the owner's approval. Never lower a count to make a run pass.

environment.note: Recorded 11 Nov 2026 from the environment that produced the accepted results. Package versions must match exactly (else pre-flight ERROR); node/npm/python versions that differ give a WARNING.

tests.name: shortage-delay

tests.name: scrap-rules
tests.note: Stage 3 scrap rules (owner, 15 Nov 2026), both routes with one case list: negative and above-100% scrap rejected; a plain decimal 0-1 or a percentage 0%-100% accepted, text conversions disclosed with the row; invalid scrap refuses the direct analysis and the import (ROW_REJECTED, Must fix) naming the row; blank = missing, 0% assumed and disclosed.
